notes: CRM notes: central ops + platform team evaluating inference vendor for mission-critical contact center. Primary ask = survive incident bursts and seasonal peaks with graceful degradation. Wants: deterministic latency SLOs for priority queues (<150ms tail for short responses), auto-failover to cheaper model variant, clear cost/throughput tradeoffs. Quote from SRE lead: 'If we lose the bot for 20 min during promos we see full escalations — needs predictable backpressure, not hard failures.' High sensitivity to unit cost during sustained spikes; open to dedicated capacity with burstable headroom. Interested in agent-assist + automated tool-calls (e.g., CRM updates via function-calling). Needs audit logs + per-customer data residency; legal flagged cross-border PII. SE notes: will test KV prefix caching for repeated context (high reuse in chat flows). Current stack: homegrown routing + Zendesk + Twilio voice; evaluating Redwood for inference layer. Next immediate: run 3-day POC with synthetic spikes and SLA measurement. Blockers: legal (data clause), proof of spike handling, internal engineering calendar for integration.
